description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git fetch negotiation algorithms and behaviors, including skipping commits, reference advertisement filtering, handling clock skew, and peer acknowledgment strategies.

methods.name: have_sent
methods.description: Checks that specific commits have been sent during fetch trace.

methods.name: have_not_sent
methods.description: Verifies that certain commits have not been sent during fetch trace.

methods.name: trace_fetch
methods.description: Function that executes a Git fetch with tracing enabled, used to monitor fetch packet exchanges.
